verdict.rationale: All PayPal agentic-commerce evidence describes checkout/cart flows (ACP, UCP, Store Sync, Agent Toolkit for orders/invoices/refunds) that explicitly involve merchant checkout sessions, carts, and UI-adjacent flows — not HTTP 402 machine-payable API monetization where an agent pays per call with no checkout UI at all. No evidence pack item mentions HTTP 402, per-call metered API payments, or a checkout-free machine payment protocol.
